# acloud_cloud_provider_node_types (Data Source)

List all Node types available on the given cloud provider

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "acloud_cloud_provider_node_types" "aws" {
  cloud_provider = "aws"
}

# Node types with at least 4 CPUs, usable as node_size.
output "large_node_types" {
  value = [for t in data.acloud_cloud_provider_node_types.aws.node_types : t.type if t.cpu >= 4]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) Slug of the cloud provider, for example `aws`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_types` (List of Object) Node types of the cloud provider, each with `type` (the name to use as `node_size`), `cpu` (number of CPUs) and `memory` (in MB). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_types))

<a id="nestedatt--node_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_types`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number)
- `memory` (Number)
- `type` (String)
